standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: The broad tabletop and weighted foot now have smooth circular silhouettes around the original fluted pedestal.

rear.note: The opposite view retains the same rounded profiles and coherent top-to-pedestal contact.

detail.note: Full detail confirms the former polygon steps are gone while the original separate pedestal flutes remain distinct.

underside.note: The closed foot and top remain complete, with the support now seated against the tabletop underside.

clay.note: Clay preserves the smooth circular outline and fluted construction without relying on surface color.

front.note: The door rim, dark glass and control dial now have clean circular outlines on the retained appliance case.

rear.note: The original closed rear housing and eased case corners remain unchanged in character.

detail.note: Full detail shows the two gaskets following the door rim rather than crossing outside it; the original display and simplified opaque door face remain.

underside.note: The lower view retains a complete closed case and attached door assembly without dangling straight gasket strips.

clay.note: Clay confirms the formerly conspicuous polygonal door and dial now read as smooth circular parts.

front.note: The body and lid now read as smooth turned forms, with a visibly open pouring spout.

rear.note: The timber handle, original base and retained controls remain attached from the opposite side.

detail.note: Full detail confirms a rounded annular lip with a recessed bore and small grip ribs aligned around the actual vertical knob.

underside.note: The base remains closed, the level scale is preserved, and the spout has a coherent thin-wall opening.

clay.note: Clay confirms the open outlet and smooth body silhouette; the inherited straight timber handle remains a simplified source detail.

front.note: The three drawer fronts retain their fine vertical flutes and clear gaps above the original brass feet.

rear.note: The simple original rear panel and side construction remain clean and complete.

detail.note: Full detail shows the reduced-cost flutes still have rounded ends and distinct narrow profiles, with no visible degradation at application scale.

underside.note: The bottom panel and four original feet remain closed and connected below the drawer case.

clay.note: Clay preserves the fine repeated drawer relief and smooth outer case after the bounded mesh-cost correction.
